title: DS Unit System
preamble:
# DS Unit System

The DS unit system. Prefix `LUNI`.

Every conversion this document defines, tier-2 and `unit formula` included, is
bit-identical on every engine ([LUNI.18.3]); `bitexact` and `nofpu` are not
capabilities. §17 and §18 record what is outstanding for embedded targets;
they are non-normative. §15 states the
unit-name resolution rules, and [LLEX.12.5] cites it as their home.
